title: Recipe reaction taste
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16. A woman at a home kitchen counter takes a bite of a freshly made pasta, closes her eyes and smiles, then gives a thumbs-up to the camera. Warm tungsten kitchen light, handheld, real home feel.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16。女性在家里厨房台面前尝一口刚做好的意面，闭眼微笑，然后对镜头竖起大拇指。温暖的钨丝灯厨房光，手持拍摄，真实居家感。
why_it_works: Reaction beats (bite, pause, smile, gesture) create a mini story within a short clip.
result_check: Fork and food interaction is believable
